rationale: This is the M-2 provisioned tenant agent. Its status was error solely because its two deployments (a7844c6b at 2026-11-06T15:15:45Z, c30ce878 at 2026-11-06T16:36:53Z) failed in build with 'Error: Source execution could not be prepared.' because no source was attached at end-users-API create time.

Official OpenAPI (read from the live spec) provides the remediation path for an existing agent: POST /api/upload/zip (validates ZIP, returns s3Key) followed by POST /api/deploy {agentId, source:'zip', uploadS3Key}. The end-users create endpoint is documented as exactly-once/idempotent (returns the existing agent), so re-calling it cannot attach source.

The Stage 1 working agent (release a0d217d) was left untouched as the verified fallback/proof, avoiding regression risk on the only working VM. No new agent was created (free tier cap maxAgents=3 already reached) and no agent was deleted.
